name: Evelynn Violeta
original_name: イヴリン・ビオレッタ
source:
The strange bishop of the Academics Department, and a librarian. Evelynn often brews perfume with flowers herself, and tends to scare off people with her eccentric personality...

That is, when she's not attracting them (though that might be as well due thanks to her perfumes' proprieties).
